Yes, that feels right. Typing "recipe" narrowed it straight down to the Serious Eats one, and having it filter as I type — without hitting a button — is exactly how I'd want to hunt through a big pile of these. Checking the name, the description, and the address all together is good; that way I'll find things whether I remember the title or just part of the web address. The count telling me how many matched is a nice touch too.

One small thing I'd want to be sure of, since I don't always type carefully: if I'd typed "Recipe" with a capital R, I'd still expect it to find the same thing. Capitalization shouldn't matter when I'm searching.
